name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm the person who has the confirmation number. At Solenzo, my digital marketing practice, I built automated confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups so no client ever has to ask what happens next, and I track every timeline and deliverable in the CRM so nothing depends on memory. I'm based in the Denver metro and happy to be in the office.

The job you describe, owning everything from signed agreement through launch, is what I did at Wix, where I coordinated 25+ client onboardings a month from kickoff to go-live and trained a team of specialists to do the same. At Birdeye I kept all but one of my 15-20 partners by catching problems early, before they became reasons to leave. I've run projects in ClickUp, Asana, and Monday.com, and I like building the templates and SOPs that make the next client easier than the last.
I'd welcome a conversation about the role and the team. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
